items.title: Preparations for advanced nuclear at ports should begin now, study concludes
items.summary: Ports should begin structured planning for advanced nuclear technology now, treating it as a long-term infrastructure and operating-model question rather than a new marine fuel, according to a new joint paper from the British Ports Association and Lloyd's Register.
